_about: Karma rules shared by all six sites, in the spirit of Karma Yoga from the Bhagavad Gita: points honour right action and effort (doing one's duty well), not results alone. The server reads these; pages never decide points. perDay limits keep it honest; each (member, action, ref) earns once.

visit.label: Abhyasa: steady practice, you came back today

feedback.label: Shared honest feedback or an idea

order.label: Took a step for your work: an order or a quote

quiz.label: Gave a quiz your full effort (pass or not)

levels: acts with full effort, unattached to reward
